title.zh: 卷十 本紀第十: 章宗二
title.raw: 卷十 本紀第十: 章宗二 Volume 10 Annals 10: Zhangzong 2

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己巳朔，以皇太后喪，不受朝。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on jisi the new moon, because of the empress dowager’s mourning, court was not held.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the jisi new moon of the first spring month, court was suspended for the empress dowager’s mourning.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以平章政事夾穀清臣為尚書右丞相，監修國史。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Participation Councillor Jiagu Qingchen was made Right Chancellor of the Secretariat and overseer of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Participation Councillor Jiagu Qingchen was made Right Chancellor of the Secretariat and charged with compiling the National History.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣戶部侍郎李獻可等分路勸農事。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Vice Minister of Revenue Li Xiank and others were sent on separate routes to urge agricultural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Vice Minister of Revenue Li Xiank and others were sent along separate routes to urge the farming season on.

sentences.zh: 癸未，尚書省奏大興府推官蘇德秀為禮部主事，上曰：「朕既嘗語卿，百官當使久於其職。

translations.literal: On guwei, the Secretariat memorialized that Su Dexiu, reviewing officer of Daxing prefecture, be made chief clerk of the Ministry of Rites. The emperor said: “I have already told you—all officials should be kept long in their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On guwei the Secretariat asked to make Su Dexiu, reviewing officer of Daxing, chief clerk in the Ministry of Rites. The emperor said, “I have already told you: keep every official long in his post.

sentences.zh: 彼方任理官，複改戶曹，尋又除禮部，人才豈能兼之？

translations.literal: He had just been a judicial officer, then was moved to the household section, and now again to Rites—how can one man’s talent cover all?
translations.idiomatic: He had just held a judicial post, then the household section, and now Rites again—can one man’s talent stretch to all of them?

sentences.zh: 若久於其職，但中材勝於新人，事既經練，亦必有濟，後不可輕易改除。

translations.literal: If kept long in office, even a middling man beats a newcomer; once affairs are practiced through, he will surely suffice. Hereafter do not lightly change appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Keep a man in office and even a middling talent beats a newcomer; once the work is practiced through, he will do. Do not lightly shuffle appointments hereafter.

sentences.zh: 」上又言：「凡稱政有異跡者，謂其斷事軼才也。

translations.literal: ” The emperor also said: “When we speak of exceptional achievement in office, we mean talent that decides cases beyond the ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: ” He also said, “When people praise a striking record in office, they mean a judge whose talent outruns the routine.

sentences.zh: 若止清廉，此乃本分，以貪污者多，故顯其異耳。

translations.literal: If one is merely clean-handed, that is one’s duty; because so many are corrupt, cleanness merely stands out.
translations.idiomatic: If he is merely clean-handed, that is his duty; because so many are corrupt, honesty only looks remarkable.

sentences.zh: 宰臣又言：'近言事者謂，方今孝弟廉恥道缺，乞正風俗。

translations.literal: The chief ministers also said: “Recent memorialists say filial piety, brotherhood, integrity, and shame are lacking now, and beg to rectify custom.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers also said, “Memorialists lately claim filial piety, brotherly duty, integrity, and shame have fallen away, and beg to set custom right.

sentences.zh: '此蓋官吏不能奉宣教化使然。

translations.literal: “This comes from officials who cannot carry out and proclaim moral teaching.
translations.idiomatic: “That comes from officials who cannot carry the court’s teaching into the counties.

sentences.zh: 今之察舉官吏者，多責近效，以幹辦為上，其有秉心寬厚，欲行德化者，輒謂之迂闊。

translations.literal: Today’s inspections of officials demand quick results and rank practical execution highest; those broad of mind who wish to practice virtue in governing are dismissed as impractical.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors today demand quick results and rank sharp execution highest; men of generous mind who would govern by moral example are called impractical.

sentences.zh: 故人人皆以教化為餘事，此孝弟所以廢也。

translations.literal: So everyone treats moral teaching as extra work—that is why filial piety perishes.
translations.idiomatic: So everyone treats teaching the people as spare work—and that is why filial piety dies.

sentences.zh: 若諭所司，官吏有能務行德化者，擢而用之，則教化可行，孝弟可興矣。

translations.literal: If offices were instructed that officials who earnestly practice moral governance be promoted and used, teaching would take hold and filial piety could rise again.
translations.idiomatic: Tell the ministries to promote officials who earnestly practice moral governance, and teaching will move, filial piety will rise again.

sentences.zh: 今之所察舉，皆先才而後德。

translations.literal: Today’s inspections always put talent before virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Today’s inspections always put talent before virtue.

sentences.zh: 巧猾之徒，雖有髒汙，一旦見用，猶為能吏，此廉恥所以喪也。

translations.literal: Clever rogues, though stained, once employed still count as capable officers—that is why integrity and shame are lost.
translations.idiomatic: Clever rogues, though filthy in conduct, once used still pass as capable men—and that is how integrity and shame are lost.

sentences.zh: 若諭所司，察舉官吏，必審真偽，使有才無行者不以覬覦，非道求進者加之糾劾，則奔兢之俗息，而廉恥可興矣！

translations.literal: If offices were told that when inspecting officials they must judge true and false, so that talented but unprincipled men do not aspire to office, and those who seek advancement by improper paths are impeached, the scramble would ease and integrity and shame could rise again!
translations.idiomatic: Tell the ministries to weigh true and false in inspection, so men of talent without conduct do not covet office, and those who advance by crooked paths are impeached—the scramble will ease, integrity and shame may rise again!

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，賑河北諸路被水災者。

translations.literal: ” On xinmao, relief was given to those afflicted by flood in the circuits of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: ” On xinmao flood victims in the Hebei circuits were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，諭點檢司：「行宮外地及圍獵之處悉與民耕，雖禁地，聽民持農器出入。

translations.literal: On guisi, instruction to the Inspection Office: “All land outside the travelling palace and at hunting grounds is to be farmed with the people; even in forbidden areas, let the people enter and leave with farm tools.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Inspection Office was instructed: “Let the people farm all land outside the travelling palaces and at the hunting grounds; even in forbidden tracts, let them carry farm tools in and out.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，東京路副使王勝進鷹，遣諭之曰：「汝職非輕，民間利害，官吏邪正，略不具聞，而乃以鷹進，此豈汝所職也！

translations.literal: ” On bingshen, Wang Sheng, deputy commissioner of the Eastern Capital circuit, presented a hawk. A message was sent telling him: “Your charge is not light—you report nothing on the people’s welfare or whether officials are upright or crooked, yet you present a hawk. Is this your duty?
translations.idiomatic: ” On bingshen Wang Sheng, deputy commissioner of the Eastern Capital circuit, presented a hawk. The court sent word: “Your charge is not light—you say nothing of the people’s welfare or whether officials are straight or crooked, yet you send a hawk. Is that your duty?

sentences.zh: 後毋複爾。」

translations.literal: Do not do so again.”
translations.idiomatic: Do not do so again.”

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌朔，如春水。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuxu the new moon, he went to the spring hunt waters.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuxu new moon, he went to the spring-waters hunt.

sentences.zh: 始以春、秋二仲月上戊日祭社稷。

translations.literal: For the first time, on the wu day of the second month of spring and autumn, sacrifice was offered to the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: For the first time the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to on the wu day of the second month of spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，獵于姚村澱。

translations.literal: On guichou, he hunted at Yaocun Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he hunted at Yaocun Marsh.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，至自春水。

translations.literal: On guihai, he returned from the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he returned from the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，參知政事張萬公罷。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Participation Councillor Zhang Wangong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Participation Councillor Zhang Wangong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰朔，諸部提刑司入見，各問以職事，仍誡諭曰：「朕特設提刑司，本欲安民，於今五年，效猶未著。

translations.literal: Third month, on wuchen the new moon, the regional Judicial Inspection Commissions were received in audience; each was questioned on his duties, and admonished: “I established the Judicial Inspection Commissions to secure the people; after five years the effect is still unclear.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the wuchen new moon, the regional Judicial Inspection commissioners were received; each was questioned on his charge and warned: “I set up the Judicial Inspection Commissions to settle the people; after five years the gain is still thin.

sentences.zh: 蓋多不識本職之體，而徒事細碎，以致州縣例皆畏宿而不敢行事。

translations.literal: Most do not know the substance of their office and busy themselves with petty matters, so prefectures and districts all fear veteran inspectors and dare not act.
translations.idiomatic: Most do not grasp the body of the office and chase petty detail, so prefectures and districts fear the seasoned inspectors and dare not act.

sentences.zh: 乃者山東民艱於食，嘗遣使賑濟，蓋卿等不職，故至於此。

translations.literal: Recently the people of Shandong were short of food and I had to send envoys with relief—that is because you failed in your duties.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the people of Shandong went hungry and I had to send relief—that is your failure in office.

sentences.zh: 既往之失，其思悛改。

translations.literal: Past faults—think to reform them.
translations.idiomatic: Past faults—think to mend them.

sentences.zh: 」庚午，上將幸景明宮，御史中丞董師中等上書切諫，不報。

translations.literal: ” On gengwu, as the emperor was about to visit Jingming Palace, Censor-in-chief Dong Shizhong and others submitted forceful remonstrances; no answer.
translations.idiomatic: ” On gengwu, as the emperor was about to visit Jingming Palace, Censor-in-chief Dong Shizhong and others submitted sharp remonstrance; no reply.

sentences.zh: 壬申，章再上，補闕許安仁、拾遺路鐸皆諫，乃止。

translations.literal: On renshen the memorial came again; Remonstrance Secretariat suppletor Xu Anren and Admonisher Lu Duo all remonstrated, and he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the memorial came again; Remonstrance Secretariat suppletor Xu Anren and Admonisher Lu Duo all remonstrated, and he desisted.

sentences.zh: 制定民習角牴，槍棒罪。

translations.literal: Penalties were fixed for the people’s practice of wrestling and staff-fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Penalties were set for the people’s wrestling and staff-fighting.

sentences.zh: 以工部尚書胥持國為參知政事。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Xu Chiguo was made Participation Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Xu Chiguo was made Participation Councillor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，特賜有司孔端甫及第，授小學教授，尋以年老，命食主簿半俸致仕。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Kong Duanfu of the Ministry of Rites was specially granted jinshi rank, appointed professor of the Primary School; soon, for old age, he was ordered to retire on half the salary of a registrar.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Kong Duanfu of the Ministry of Rites was specially granted jinshi rank and made professor of the Primary School; soon, for age, he was retired on half a registrar’s salary.

sentences.zh: 甲申，幸香山永安寺及玉泉山。

translations.literal: On jiashen, he visited Yong’an Temple on Fragrant Hill and Jade Spring Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he visited Yong’an Temple on Fragrant Hill and Jade Spring Mountain.

sentences.zh: 甲午，定配享功臣。

translations.literal: On jiawu, accompanying sacrifice for meritorious ministers was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the meritorious ministers who share in sacrifice were fixed.

sentences.zh: 敕自今御史台奏事，修起居注並令回避。

translations.literal: Edict: henceforth when the Censorate presents business, the compilers of the Veritable Record were all ordered to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ruled that when the Censorate presented business from now on, the compilers of the Veritable Record must withdraw.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉朔，幸興陵崇妃第。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dingyou the new moon, he visited the residence of the Honored Consort at Xing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the dingyou new moon, he visited the Honored Consort’s lodge at Xing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 是日，始舉樂。

translations.literal: That day music was first performed.
translations.idiomatic: That day music was first performed.

sentences.zh: 自己亥至癸卯，百官三表請上尊號，上曰：「祖宗古先有受尊號者，蓋有其德，故有其名。

translations.literal: From jihai to guimao the hundred officials thrice memorialized begging an honorific title. The emperor said: “Among the ancients our ancestors who received honorific titles had the virtue, and therefore the name.
translations.idiomatic: From jihai to guimao the hundred officials thrice begged an honorific title. The emperor said, “Among the ancients, those of our line who took honorific titles had the virtue, and so earned the name.

sentences.zh: 比年五穀不登，百姓流離，正當戒懼修身之日，豈得虛受榮名耶？

translations.literal: In recent years the five grains have not ripened and the people wander in exile—this is precisely when one should guard oneself in fear and cultivate the person. How can I falsely receive a glorious name?
translations.idiomatic: These last years the five grains have failed and the people drift in exile—this is the very hour to fear, mend the self, and walk carefully. How can I take an empty glory?

sentences.zh: 」不許，仍斷來章。

translations.literal: ” He did not permit it and still cut off incoming memorials.
translations.idiomatic: ” He refused and still barred further memorials on the matter.

sentences.zh: 戊申，親禘於太廟。

translations.literal: On wushen, he personally performed the di sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he personally performed the di sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On gengxu, he went to the Palace of Ten Thousand Tranquilities.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he went to the Palace of Ten Thousand Tranquilities.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，右丞相清臣率百官及耋艾等複請上尊號，學官劉璣亦率六學諸生趙楷等七百九十五人詣紫宸門請上尊號，如唐元和故事，不許。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Right Chancellor Qingchen led the hundred officials and elders again to beg an honorific title; academy officer Liu Ji also led seven hundred ninety-five students of the Six Schools including Zhao Kai to the Zichen Gate to beg an honorific title, after the Tang Yuanhe precedent. He did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Right Chancellor Qingchen led the hundred officials and white-haired elders to beg an honorific title again; academy officer Liu Ji led seven hundred ninety-five students of the Six Schools, including Zhao Kai, to the Zichen Gate with the same plea, citing the Tang Yuanhe precedent. He refused.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賑河州饑。

translations.literal: On dingsi, relief was given for famine in Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi famine in Hezhou was relieved.

sentences.zh: 敕女直進士及第後，仍試以騎射，中選者升擢之。

translations.literal: Edict: After Jurchen jinshi passed the examination, they were still tested in mounted archery; those who qualified were promoted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ruled that Jurchen jinshi, after passing the written examination, were still tested in mounted archery; those who qualified were promoted.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，減尚廄食谷馬。

translations.literal: On yichou, grain-fed horses in the Imperial Stud were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou grain-fed horses in the Imperial Stud were cut back.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅朔，曹王永升及諸王請上尊號，不許。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on bingyin the new moon, the Prince of Cao, Yong Sheng, and the princes begged an honorific title. He did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingyin new moon, the Prince of Cao, Yong Sheng, and the other princes begged an honorific title. He refused.

sentences.zh: 以尚廄局使石抹貞為橫賜夏國使。

translations.literal: Shi Mo Zhen, commissioner of the Imperial Stud bureau, was made cross-bestowal envoy to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Mo Zhen, commissioner of the Imperial Stud bureau, was made envoy bearing cross-border gifts to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上以群臣累上尊號不受，詔諭中外，徒罪以下遞降一等，杖以下原之。

translations.literal: On jisi, because the officials had repeatedly asked him to accept an honorific title and he had not, an edict announced this within and without; penal servitude and below were reduced one grade, beating-punishment and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, having refused the officials’ repeated requests for an honorific title, he issued an edict to court and realm; penal servitude was cut one grade and lesser beatings were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，觀稼於近郊。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, he viewed the crops in the nearby suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he inspected the harvest in the suburbs near the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，諭左司：「遍諭諸路，令月具雨澤田禾分數以聞。

translations.literal: On xinsi, he instructed the Left Office: 「Order every circuit to report monthly the fraction of rainfall, moisture, fields, and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he told the Left Office: 「Every circuit must report monthly how much rain, moisture, field, and crop there is.

sentences.zh: 」癸未，以久雨，鋋。

translations.literal: 」On guiwei, because of prolonged rain, court was curtailed.
translations.idiomatic: 」On guiwei prolonged rain led him to curtail court.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，樞密使襄帥百僚再請上尊號，不許。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jihai, Military Affairs Commissioner Xiang led the hundred officials again to ask for an honorific title; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jihai, Military Affairs Commissioner Xiang again led the hundred officials to request an honorific title; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 是日，歲星、太白晝見。

translations.literal: That day, Jupiter and Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: That day Jupiter and Venus were visible by day.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大赦。

translations.literal: On gengzi, general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，至自萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On jiachen, returned from Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he returned from Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁未，釋奠孔子廟，北面再拜。

translations.literal: On dingwei, offered the Confucian sacrifice at the Confucius temple, bowing twice facing north.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he performed the Confucian offering at the Confucius temple, bowing twice toward the north.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，國史院進《世宗實錄》，上服袍帶，禦仁政殿，降座，立受之。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Historiography Institute presented the Veritable Records of Shizong; the emperor wore robe and belt, attended at Renzheng Hall, descended the throne, and received them standing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Historiography Institute presented the Veritable Records of Shizong; wearing court robe and belt he attended at Renzheng Hall, stepped down, and received the volumes standing.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子朔，天壽節，禦大安殿，受親王百官及宋、高麗、夏使朝賀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on jiazi, Heavenly Longevity Festival; at Great Peace Hall he received congratulations from imperial princes, the hundred officials, and envoys of Song, Goryeo, and Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, new moon on jiazi: Heavenly Longevity Festival; at Great Peace Hall he received congratulations from princes, officials, and envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Xia.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以參知政事來谷衡為尚書右丞，戶部尚書馬琪為參知政事。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Participation Councillor Jiagu Heng was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat; Minister of Revenue Ma Qi was made Participation Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Participation Councillor Jiagu Heng became Right Vice Director of the Secretariat and Minister of Revenue Ma Qi became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 敕尚書省：「大定二十九年以後土庶言事，或系國家或邊關大利害已嘗施行者，可特補一官，有益於官民，量給以賞。

translations.literal: Ordered the Secretariat: 「After the twenty-ninth year of Dading, when commoners submitted proposals on matters concerning the state or major border interests that had already been implemented, they may be specially granted one office; where there is benefit to officials and people, rewards should be given in measure.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Secretariat: 「From the twenty-ninth year of Dading onward, commoners who raised state or frontier proposals that had already been put into effect might receive a special appointment; where officials and people benefited, graded rewards were to be given.

sentences.zh: 」以西上閣門使大枿為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: 」Western Upper Inner Attendants Gate Commissioner Da Nie was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: 」Da Nie, Western Upper Inner Attendants Gate commissioner, was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 庚午，如山陵，次奉先縣。

translations.literal: On gengwu, went toward the imperial tombs, halting at Fengxian County.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he set out for the imperial tombs and halted at Fengxian County.

sentences.zh: 辛未，拜天於縣西。

translations.literal: On xinwei, worshipped Heaven west of the county.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he worshipped Heaven west of the county seat.

sentences.zh: 壬申，致奠諸陵。

translations.literal: On renshen, offered sacrifice at the various tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he offered sacrifice at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，如秋山。

translations.literal: On guiyou, went to Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he went to Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，右丞相清臣、參知政事持國上表丐閑，優詔不許。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on gengwu, Right Chancellor Qingchen and Participation Councillor Chiguo submitted memorials begging leave; a gracious edict refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengwu, Right Chancellor Qingchen and Participation Councillor Chiguo memorialized asking to retire; a gracious edict would not allow it.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以翰林直學士完顏匡等為賀宋正旦使，命匡權易名弼，以避宋諱。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Hanlin Direct Academician Wanyan Kuang and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year; Kuang was temporarily renamed Bi to avoid Song taboo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Hanlin direct academician Wanyan Kuang and others were sent as Song New Year envoys; Kuang was temporarily renamed Bi to avoid a Song taboo.

sentences.zh: 壬午，木冰。

translations.literal: On renwu, tree ice.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu there was tree ice.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔諸職官以贓汙不職被罪、以廉能獲升者，令隨路、京、府、州、縣列其姓名，揭之公署，以示勸懲。

translations.literal: On bingxu, an edict ordered that officials convicted of corruption and incompetence or promoted for integrity and ability should have their names listed by circuit, capital, prefecture, state, and county and posted at public offices to encourage and warn.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu an edict required each circuit, capital, prefecture, state, and county to post the names of officials punished for corruption or incompetence and those raised for integrity, as encouragement and warning.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，夏國嗣子李純佑遣使來訃告。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Western Xia heir Li Chunyou sent envoys bearing news of a death.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Western Xia heir Li Chunyou sent envoys announcing a bereavement.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午朔，夏國李純佑遣使奉故王仁孝遣表以進。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on jiawu, Li Chunyou of Western Xia sent envoys presenting the late king Renxiao’s final memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, new moon on jiawu: Li Chunyou of Western Xia sent envoys presenting the late King Renxiao’s final memorial.

sentences.zh: 諭大興府于暖湯院日給米五石，以贍貧者。

translations.literal: Ordered Daxing prefecture to give five shi of grain daily at Nuantang Courtyard to support the poor.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Daxing prefecture to issue five shi of grain daily at Nuantang Courtyard to feed the poor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，定武軍節度使鄭王永蹈以謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Defender-General of Dingwu Army Prince of Zheng Yongtao was executed for plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Prince of Zheng Yongtao, defender-general of Dingwu Army, was executed for rebellion.

sentences.zh: 己亥，諭有司，以鄭王財產分賜諸王，澤國公主財物分賜諸公主。

translations.literal: On jihai, ordered the relevant offices to distribute Prince of Zheng’s property among the princes and Princess of Zeguo’s goods among the princesses.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he ordered Prince of Zheng’s property divided among the princes and Princess of Zeguo’s goods divided among the princesses.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，諸王府增置司馬一人。

translations.literal: On jiachen, one Administrative Aide was added to each princely mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen each princely mansion gained one administrative aide.

sentences.zh: 以紇石烈珵為高麗生日使，西上閣門使大枿等為夏國敕祭慰問使。

translations.literal: Hegeshilie Cheng was made Goryeo birthday envoy; Da Nie and others were made Western Xia envoys under imperial command for sacrifice and condolence.
translations.idiomatic: Hegeshilie Cheng was sent as Goryeo birthday envoy; Da Nie and others were sent under imperial command to offer sacrifice and condolences in Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，尚書省以科目近多得人，乞是舉增取進士。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the Secretariat reported that recent examinations had yielded many men and asked to increase the jinshi quota this round.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Secretariat said recent examinations had produced many candidates and asked to enlarge the jinshi intake this session.

sentences.zh: 上然之，詔有司：「會試毋限人數。

translations.literal: The emperor agreed and ordered the relevant offices: 「The palace examination shall not limit numbers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed and ordered: 「The palace examination shall set no cap on numbers.

sentences.zh: 」甲寅，冊長白山之神為開天弘聖帝。

translations.literal: 」On jiayin, Changbai Mountain’s spirit was enfeoffed as Emperor Opening Heaven and Vast Sagely.
translations.idiomatic: 」On jiayin the spirit of Changbai Mountain was enfeoffed as Emperor Opening Heaven and Vast Sagely.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On bingchen, hunted in the nearby suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he hunted in the nearby suburbs.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大有年。

translations.literal: This year brought a great harvest.
translations.idiomatic: That year brought a great harvest.

sentences.zh: 邢、洺、深、冀及河北西路十六謀克之地，野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: In Xing, Mo, Shen, Ji, and sixteen meng’an districts of Hebei West Circuit, wild silkworms formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: In Xing, Mo, Shen, Ji, and sixteen meng’an districts on the Hebei West Circuit, wild silkworms spun cocoons.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, new moon on gui, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, spring, new moon on gui: congratulatory envoys came from Song, Goryeo, and Xia.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，昭容李氏進位淑妃。

translations.literal: On yichou, Lady of Encouraging Countenance Li was advanced to Honorable Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Lady of Encouraging Countenance Li was promoted to Honorable Consort.

sentences.zh: 己巳，初用唐、宋典禮，皇后忌辰皆廢務。

translations.literal: On jisi, for the first time Tang and Song rites were adopted: on the empress’s death anniversary all duties were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Tang and Song precedent was adopted for the first time: on the empress’s death anniversary all business ceased.

sentences.zh: 尚書省進區田法，詔相其地宜，務從民便。

translations.literal: The Secretariat presented the zone-field law; an edict directed surveying what suited the land and prioritizing convenience for the people.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat submitted the zone-field law; an edict ordered the land surveyed for suitability and the people’s convenience made the rule.

sentences.zh: 又言遣官劭農之擾，命提刑司禁止之。

translations.literal: They also said that officials sent to encourage farming were a nuisance; the Judicial Inspection Commission was ordered to forbid it.
translations.idiomatic: They also reported that farming-promotion envoys were a burden; the Judicial Inspection Commission was told to stop it.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以葉魯、穀神始制女直字，詔加封贈，依倉頡立廟盩厔例，祠於上京納裏渾莊。

translations.literal: On yihai, because Yeru and Gushen first devised Jurchen characters, an edict added posthumous honors, following the precedent of Cang Jie’s temple at Meizhi, with sacrifice at Nali Hun Village in Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, because Yeru and Gushen first created Jurchen script, an edict granted posthumous honors and, following Cang Jie’s temple at Meizhi, established rites at Nali Hun Village in the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 歲時致祭，令其子孫拜奠，本路官一人及本千戶春秋二祭。

translations.literal: Seasonal sacrifices were established; descendants should bow and offer; one official of the circuit and the local chiliarch should perform spring and autumn rites.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal sacrifices were ordered; descendants were to bow and offer, with one circuit official and the local chiliarch performing spring and autumn rites.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，前中都路都轉運使王寂薦三舉終場人蔡州文商經明行修，足備顧問。

translations.literal: On xinsi, former Metropolitan Transport Commissioner of Central Capital Circuit Wang Ji recommended Wen Shang of Cai prefecture, who had completed three examination rounds, as clear in the classics and upright in conduct, fit to advise.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi former Central Capital metropolitan transport commissioner Wang Ji recommended Wen Shang of Cai prefecture, a three-time examination finisher, as versed in the classics and upright—fit for counsel.

sentences.zh: 前河北西路轉連使李揚言慶陽府進士李獎純德博學，鄉曲譽之。

translations.literal: Former Hebei West Circuit transport commissioner Li Yang said Li Jiang of Qingyang prefecture, jinshi, was pure in virtue and broad in learning, praised in the countryside.
translations.idiomatic: Former Hebei West transport commissioner Li Yang said Qingyang jinshi Li Jiang was pure in conduct and broad in learning and praised locally.

sentences.zh: 絳州李天祺、應州康晉侯屢赴廷試，皆有才德。

translations.literal: Li Tianqi of Jiang prefecture and Kang Jinhou of Ying prefecture had repeatedly attended palace examinations; both had talent and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tianqi of Jiang prefecture and Kang Jinhou of Ying prefecture had repeatedly sat the palace examination; both had talent and character.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「文商可令召之。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 「Wen Shang may be summoned.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 「Summon Wen Shang.

sentences.zh: 李獎給主簿半俸終身，余賜同進士出身。

translations.literal: Li Jiang was given registry-clerk half salary for life; the rest were granted tong jinshi origin.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiang received a registry clerk’s half salary for life; the others were granted tong jinshi standing.

sentences.zh: 」遣國子祭酒劉璣冊李純佑為夏國王。

translations.literal: 」He dispatched Guozijian Chancellor Liu Ji to invest Li Chunyou as king of Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: 」He sent Guozijian chancellor Liu Ji to invest Li Chunyou as king of Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸城南別宮。

translations.literal: On dinghai, visited the southern suburban detached palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he visited the detached palace south of the city.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，初定限錢禁。

translations.literal: Third month, on renshen, the ban on limit-money was first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on renshen: the limit-money prohibition was first established.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，初定日月風雨雷師常祀。

translations.literal: On gengchen the regular sacrifices to the sun, moon, wind, rain, and thunder deities were first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the standing rites for the sun, moon, wind, rain, and thunder gods were first established.

sentences.zh: 戊子，置弘文院，譯寫經書。

translations.literal: On wuzi the Hongwen Academy was established to translate and copy scriptures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Academy for the Advancement of Literature was set up to translate and transcribe the classics.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰朔，幸北苑。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on renchen: he visited the Northern Park.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, new moon on renchen, he went to the Northern Park.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔各路所舉德行才能之士，涿州時琦、雲中劉摯、鄭州李升、恩州傅礪、濟南趙摯、興中田扈方六人，並特賜同進士出身。

translations.literal: On gengzi an edict [said that] of the men of virtue and talent recommended on each route—Zhuozhou’s Shi Qi, Yunzhong’s Liu Zhi, Zhengzhou’s Li Sheng, Enzhou’s Fu Li, Jinan’s Zhao Zhi, and Xingzhong’s Tian Hu, six men—all were specially granted tongjinshi status.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict named six men of virtue and talent whom the circuits had recommended—Shi Qi of Zhuozhou, Liu Zhi of Yunzhong, Li Sheng of Zhengzhou, Fu Li of Enzhou, Zhao Zhi of Jinan, and Tian Hu of Xingzhong—and specially granted each the standing of a tongjinshi graduate.

sentences.zh: 以文商為國子教授，特遷登仕郎。

translations.literal: Wen Shang was made professor of the Imperial Academy and specially promoted to Dengshilang.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Shang was appointed professor of the Imperial Academy and specially advanced to Dengshilang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔自今筐櫝床榻之飾毋以金玉。

translations.literal: On jiyou an edict: from now on ornamentation on baskets, cases, beds, and couches must not use gold or jade.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou an edict forbade gold or jade trim on baskets, cases, beds, and couches from that time forward.

sentences.zh: 壬子，特賜翰林待制溫蒂罕迪翰林學士承旨、中奉大夫。

translations.literal: On renzi Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting Wendihandi was specially granted Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Zhongfeng dafu.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Wendihandi, Hanlin attendant-in-waiting, was specially made Hanlin expositor-in-chief and Zhongfeng dafu.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幸景明宮，董師中、賈守謙、路鐸先後凡兩上封事切諫，不報。

translations.literal: On yimao he visited Jingming Palace; Dong Shizhong, Jia Shouqian, and Lu Duo in succession twice submitted sealed memorials urging firmly—no response.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he went to Jingming Palace; Dong Shizhong, Jia Shouqian, and Lu Duo each submitted sealed remonstrances twice in turn—none was answered.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，次烏十撒八。

translations.literal: Fifth month, gengwu: he halted at Wushisaba.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu, he encamped at Wushisaba.

sentences.zh: 戊子，桓、撫二州旱，遣使禱於縉山。

translations.literal: On wuzi Huan and Fu prefectures suffered drought; envoys were sent to pray at Mount Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi drought struck Huan and Fu prefectures; envoys were dispatched to pray at Mount Jin.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，如冰井。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renchen: he went to Bingjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen, he went to Bingjing.

sentences.zh: 己亥，出獵。

translations.literal: On jihai he went out hunting.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he went out to hunt.

sentences.zh: 登胡土白山。

translations.literal: He ascended Mount Hutubai.
translations.idiomatic: He climbed Mount Hutubai.

sentences.zh: 酹酒再拜。

translations.literal: He poured libation and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: He offered libation and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 曹王永升以下進酒。

translations.literal: Prince of Cao Yong Sheng and those below presented wine.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Cao, Yong Sheng, and those of lower rank presented wine.

sentences.zh: 丙午，拜天，曲赦西北路，己未，如查沙秋山。

translations.literal: On bingwu he worshipped Heaven; a partial amnesty for the Northwest Route; on jiwei he went to Mount Chashachiu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he worshipped Heaven and granted a partial amnesty in the Northwest Route; on jiwei he went to Mount Chashachiu.

sentences.zh: 是月，宋前主甗殂。

translations.literal: That month the former Song ruler died.
translations.idiomatic: That month the former Song sovereign died.

sentences.zh: 七月戊辰，獵於豁赤火，一發貫雙鹿。

translations.literal: Seventh month, wuchen: he hunted at Huochihuo; one shot pierced two deer.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wuchen, he hunted at Huochihuo and with one shot transfixed two deer.

sentences.zh: 是日，獲鹿二百二十二，賜扈從官有差。

translations.literal: That day two hundred twenty-two deer were taken; attendants were rewarded in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: That day two hundred twenty-two deer were bagged; those in attendance were rewarded according to rank.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，次魯溫合失不。

translations.literal: On xinsi he halted at Luwenheshibu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he encamped at Luwenheshibu.

sentences.zh: 是日，上親射，獲黃羊四百七十一。

translations.literal: That day the emperor shot in person and took four hundred seventy-one yellow sheep.
translations.idiomatic: That day he shot himself and took four hundred seventy-one yellow sheep.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，次冰井。

translations.literal: On yiyou he halted at Bingjing.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he encamped at Bingjing.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以天壽節，宴樞光殿，凡從官及承應人遇覃恩遷秩者，並受宣敕於殿前。

translations.literal: On bingxu, it being the Heavenly Longevity Festival, a banquet was held at Shuguang Hall; all attendants and service staff who received grace promotions in rank received their edicts of appointment before the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Heavenly Longevity Festival, he feasted at Shuguang Hall; every attendant and palace servant who gained a grace promotion received the appointment edict in front of the hall.

sentences.zh: 時久雨初霽，有龍曳尾於殿前雲間。

translations.literal: The long rains had just cleared; a dragon dragged its tail through the clouds before the hall.
translations.idiomatic: After long rain the sky had just cleared; a dragon trailed its tail in the clouds before the hall.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禦膳羹中有發，上舉視而棄之，戒左右毋宣言。

translations.literal: On wuzi there was hair in the imperial broth; the emperor lifted it, looked, and cast it aside, warning those nearby not to speak of it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi a hair appeared in the imperial soup; the emperor looked, set it aside, and told those about him to say nothing.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，至自景明宮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinhai: he returned from Jingming Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinhai, he returned from Jingming Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬子，河決陽武故堤，灌封丘而東。

translations.literal: On renzi the Yellow River breached the old dike at Yangwu and flooded east past Fengqiu.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Yellow River broke the old Yangwu dike and poured eastward past Fengqiu.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賜從幸山后親軍銀、絹有差。

translations.literal: On dingsi the empress’s guard who had followed the mountain tour were given graded gifts of silver and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the empress’s guard who had accompanied the mountain progress received silver and silk in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午朔，天壽節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on wuwu, Heavenly Longevity Festival: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, new moon on wuwu, the Heavenly Longevity Festival: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命增定捕盜官被殺賻錢及官賞格。

translations.literal: On renxu an order increased the compensation money and official reward scales when bandit-catchers were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an order raised the death-compensation payments and official bounty scales for slain bandit-catchers.

sentences.zh: 甲子，都水監官王汝嘉等坐河決，各削官兩階，杖七十，罷之。

translations.literal: On jiazi Directorate of Waterways officers Wang Rujia and others, guilty of the river breach, each had two ranks stripped, received seventy blows of the staff, and were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Wang Rujia and other Directorate of Waterways officers, held responsible for the breach, were each demoted two ranks, beaten seventy strokes, and removed from office.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上禦睿思殿，諸路提刑使入見。

translations.literal: On yichou the emperor held court at Ruisi Hall; circuit intendants for criminal review were received in audience.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he held court at Ruisi Hall and received the circuit intendants for criminal review.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，初令民買撲隨處金、銀、銅冶。

translations.literal: On wuchen for the first time commoners were allowed to buy franchises to gold, silver, and copper mines wherever found.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen commoners were first permitted to purchase mining franchises for gold, silver, and copper wherever deposits lay.

sentences.zh: 命參知政事馬琪往視河決，仍許便宜從事。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Ma Qi was sent to inspect the river breach, with authority to act as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: Participation Councillor Ma Qi was dispatched to inspect the breach, empowered to act at discretion.

sentences.zh: 壬申，宋主遣使來告哀。

translations.literal: On renshen the Song ruler sent envoys to announce mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Song emperor sent envoys to announce mourning.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以知大興府事尼厖古等為鑒宋國弔祭使。

translations.literal: On wuyin Nipangguji and others, knowing the affairs of Daxing prefecture, were made envoys to observe and mourn the Song state.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Nipangguji and others, metropolitan officials of Daxing, were appointed envoys to observe and mourn in Song.

sentences.zh: 敕尚書省，集百官議備邊事。

translations.literal: An edict to the Department of State Affairs ordered all officials assembled to deliberate on border defense.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed the Department of State Affairs to convene the officials and deliberate on frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 壬午，特推恩東宮舊人司經王伯溫等八人官有差。

translations.literal: On renwu a special grace raised eight former Eastern Palace staff, including Classics Reader Wang Bowen, by graded offices.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu a special grace advanced eight former Eastern Palace men, including Classics Reader Wang Bowen, by graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命上京等九路並諸抹及糺等處選軍三萬，俟來春調發，仍命諸路並北阻棨以六年夏會兵臨潢。

translations.literal: On jiashen an order directed the nine routes including Shangjing and all mo and jiu districts to select thirty thousand troops for mobilization next spring; all routes and the northern chief Zuxu were also ordered to assemble at Linhuang in summer of the sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen an order told the nine routes including Shangjing and every mo and jiu district to choose thirty thousand soldiers for spring mobilization; every route and the northern chief Zuxu were also to muster at Linhuang in summer of the sixth year.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，右丞相夾谷清臣等表請上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: Tenth winter month, gengyin: Right Chancellor Jiagu Qingchen and others memorialized requesting an honorific title; not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on gengyin: Right Chancellor Jiagu Qingchen and others asked that an honorific title be accepted; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 宋遺使獻遣留物。

translations.literal: Song sent envoys presenting leftover tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Song sent envoys bearing leftover tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，右丞相清臣複清上尊號，國子祭酒劉璣亦率六學諸生上表陳請，不允。

translations.literal: On renyin Right Chancellor Qingchen again earnestly requested an honorific title; National University Rector Liu Ji also led the six academies’ students in a memorial petition; not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Right Chancellor Qingchen again pressed for an honorific title; National University Rector Liu Ji led the six academies’ students in a joint petition as well; again refused.

sentences.zh: 遣戶部員外郎何格賑河決被災人戶。

translations.literal: Households Ministry Vice Director He Ge was sent to relieve those afflicted by the river breach.
translations.idiomatic: Households Ministry Vice Director He Ge was dispatched to relieve households stricken by the breach.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，張汝弼妻高陀斡以謀逆，伏誅。

translations.literal: On gengxu Zhang Rubi’s wife Gaotuogan, for plotting rebellion, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Gaotuogan, wife of Zhang Rubi, was executed for plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 壬子，尚書省奏，升提刑司所察廉官南皮縣令史肅以下十有二人，而大興主簿蒙括蠻都亦在選中，上知其人，曰：「蠻都澆浮人也，升之可乎？

translations.literal: On renzi the Department memorialized promoting twelve incorrupt officials investigated by the Circuit Intendancy, including Nanpi county magistrate Shi Su and others; Daxing registrar Mengkuo Mandu was also on the list. Knowing the man, the emperor said: “Mandu is a frivolous character—should he be promoted?
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Department reported promoting twelve incorrupt officials found by the circuit intendancy, including Nanpi magistrate Shi Su and others; Daxing registrar Mengkuo Mandu was also named. Knowing him, the emperor said: “Mandu is a slick man—should he rise?

sentences.zh: 與其任澆浮，孰若用淳厚。

translations.literal: Better employ the sincere and solid than place the frivolous in office.
translations.idiomatic: Better seat the honest and steady than put the slick in charge.

sentences.zh: 況蠻都常才，才智過人猶不當用，恐敗風俗，況常才耶！

translations.literal: Even if Mandu had outstanding talent he should not be used, lest custom be ruined—and he is merely ordinary ability!
translations.idiomatic: Even with outstanding talent he should not be used, lest morals suffer—and he is only middling ability!

sentences.zh: 其再察之。」

translations.literal: Investigate again.”
translations.idiomatic: Look into it again.”

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，詔罷紫荊嶺所護圍場。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guisi: an edict abolished the preserve at Zijing Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guisi, an edict closed the hunting preserve at Zijing Ridge.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以右宣徽使移剌敏等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On gengzi Right Xuanhui Court commissioner Yila Min and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Yila Min, commissioner of the Right Xuanhui Court, and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the new year.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On guichou Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，平章政事完顏守貞罷。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on xinyou Participation Councillor Wanyan Shouzhen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, Participation Councillor Wanyan Shouzhen left office.

sentences.zh: 以知大興府事尼厖古鑒為參知政事，以戶中郎中李敬義為賜高麗生日使。

translations.literal: Metropolitan Governor Nimoguchu Jian was made participation councillor; Ministry of Revenue director Li Jingyi was made Goryeo birthday-bestowal envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Metropolitan Governor Nimoguchu Jian was appointed participation councillor, and Ministry of Revenue Director Li Jingyi was sent as envoy bearing birthday gifts to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，免被黃河水災今年秋稅。

translations.literal: On dingmao autumn tax for this year was remitted for those stricken by Yellow River flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao this year’s autumn tax was waived for households hit by Yellow River flooding.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，敕減修內司備營造軍千人，都城所五百人。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict reduced the Inner Repairs Office’s reserve construction troops by a thousand and the Capital Construction Office by five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the court ordered the Inner Repairs Office to cut its reserve construction troops by a thousand and the Capital Construction Office by five hundred.

sentences.zh: 癸未，敕尚書省，自今獻靈芝嘉禾者賞。

translations.literal: On guimao an edict to the Secretariat: from now on those who present lingzhi or fine-grain rice will be rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Secretariat was told that from then on anyone presenting lingzhi or auspicious grain would receive a reward.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月丁亥朔，受宋、高麗、夏使朝賀。

translations.literal: Year six, spring, first month, on dinghai the new moon, congratulatory audiences were received from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia envoys.
translations.idiomatic: In year six, on the dinghai new moon of the first spring month, congratulatory envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia were received at court.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On gengyin Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，敕有司給天水郡公家屬田宅。

translations.literal: On xinmao an edict ordered the relevant offices to grant farmland and residences to the family of the Duke of Tianshui Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the court ordered officials to grant farmland and houses to the household of the Duke of Tianshui Commandery.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，如春水。

translations.literal: On renchen he went to the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he went to the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，罷陝西括地。

translations.literal: On gengxu the Shaanxi land survey was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Shaanxi land-registration survey was abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，諭胥持國，河上役夫聚居，恐生疾疫，可廩醫護視之。

translations.literal: On xinhai he instructed Xu Chiguo: corvée laborers along the river are massed together and epidemics may arise; they may be provisioned and given medical care.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he told Xu Chiguo that corvée workers on the river were crowded together and disease might break out, and that they should be fed from government stores and cared for by physicians.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，次禦林。

translations.literal: On yimao he halted at Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he halted at Yulin.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳朔，敕有司：「行宮側及獵所有農者勿禁。

translations.literal: Second month, on dingsi the new moon, an edict to relevant offices: "At the traveling palace periphery and at hunting grounds, farmers are not to be prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the dingsi new moon, the court ordered: "At the traveling palace and at hunting grounds, farmers are not to be barred.

sentences.zh: 」己未，始祭高禖。

translations.literal: " On jiwei the Gao Shrine sacrifice was first performed.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiwei the Gao Shrine rite was performed for the first time.

sentences.zh: 庚午，至自春水。

translations.literal: On gengwu he returned from the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he returned from the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，京師地震。

translations.literal: On dingchou the capital region had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the capital region was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 大雨雹，晝晦，震應天門右鴟尾。

translations.literal: Heavy rain and hail fell; day grew dark; lightning struck the right chirwei of Yingtian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rain and hail fell, daylight dimmed, and lightning struck the right chirwei ornament on Yingtian Gate.

sentences.zh: 癸未，宋遣使來報謝。

translations.literal: On guimao Song sent envoys to report thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Song sent envoys to present thanks.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingxu the new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingxu new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以翰林直學士孛朮魯子元兼右司諫，監察御史田仲禮為左拾遣，翰林修撰僕散訛可兼右拾遺，諭之曰：「國家設置諫官，非取虛名，蓋責實效，庶幾有所裨益。

translations.literal: On jiawu Hanlin direct academician Boluchu Ziyuan was also made right remonstrance office examiner; Supervising Censor Tian Zhongli was made left remonstrance supplicator; Hanlin reviser Pusan Woke was also made right remonstrance supplicator. He instructed them: "The state establishes remonstrance officials not for empty reputation but to expect real effect, so there may be some benefit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Boluchu Ziyuan, Hanlin direct academician, was also made right remonstrance office examiner; Supervising Censor Tian Zhongli was appointed left remonstrance supplicator; and Hanlin reviser Pusan Woke was also made right remonstrance supplicator. He told them, "The court sets up remonstrance posts not for show but to demand results that may truly help the state.

sentences.zh: 卿等皆朝廷選擢，置之諫職，如國家利害、官吏邪正，極言無隱。

translations.literal: You were all selected by the court and placed in remonstrance posts; on state profit and loss and officials’ wickedness and righteousness, speak without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: You were all chosen by the court for remonstrance duty; on what helps or harms the realm and on whether officials are upright or corrupt, speak plainly and hold nothing back.

sentences.zh: 近路鐸左遷，本以他罪，卿等勿以被責，遂畏縮不言，其悉心戮力，毋得緘默。

translations.literal: Recently Lu Duo was demoted for other crimes; do not, because you were rebuked, shrink back in fear and not speak. Exhaust your minds and strength; do not be silent.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Duo’s recent demotion was for other offenses; do not let fear of rebuke make you hold back. Give your full effort and do not stay silent.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: " On bingchen he went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingchen he went to Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以北邊糧運，括群牧所、三招討司猛安謀克、隨糺及迭剌、唐古部諸抹、西京、太原官民駝五千充之，惟民以駝載為業者勿括。

translations.literal: On wuxu, for northern border grain transport, military households of herds offices, the three pacification commissioners’ meng’an-mouke, suijiu, and Tiele, Tanggu tribal camps, and camels of officials and commoners in Western Capital and Taiyuan—five thousand in all—were surveyed to fill the need; only those whose livelihood depended on camel transport were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, to move grain to the northern frontier, the court surveyed five thousand camels from herds offices, the three pacification commissioners’ meng’an-mouke, suijiu and Tiele units, Tanggu tribal camps, and officials and commoners in Western Capital and Taiyuan, exempting only people who made their living hauling by camel.

sentences.zh: 以銀五十萬兩、錢二十三萬六千九百貫以備支給。

translations.literal: Five hundred thousand taels of silver and 236,900 strings of cash were set aside for disbursement.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred thousand taels of silver and 236,900 strings of cash were earmarked for expenses.

sentences.zh: 銀五萬兩、金盂二千八百兩、金牌百兩、銀盂八千兩、絹五萬匹、雜彩千端、衣四百四十六襲以備賞勞。

translations.literal: Fifty thousand taels of silver, 2,800 jin of gold bowls, one hundred jin of gold plaques, eight thousand silver bowls, fifty thousand bolts of silk, a thousand lengths of mixed silks, and 446 suits of clothing were set aside for rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty thousand taels of silver, 2,800 jin of gold bowls, one hundred jin of gold plaques, eight thousand silver bowls, fifty thousand bolts of silk, a thousand lengths of patterned silks, and 446 suits of clothing were prepared as rewards.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以郡舉才行之士翟介然以下三人特賜進士及第，李貞固以下十五人同進士出身。

translations.literal: On gengzi three men including Zhai Jieran, talent recommended by their prefectures, were specially granted jinshi jidi; fifteen men including Li Zhengu were granted tong jinshi chushen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi three prefectural nominees for talent and conduct, including Zhai Jieran, were specially granted jinshi jidi, and fifteen others including Li Zhengu received tong jinshi chushen.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，敕有司：「以增修曲阜宣聖廟工畢，賜衍聖公以下三獻法服及登歌樂一部，仍遣太常舊工往教孔氏子弟，以備祭禮。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guihai an edict to relevant offices: "Because repair and expansion of the Confucius temple at Qufu is complete, grant the Duke of Fulfilling the Sage and the three offering officers ritual robes and a set of ascent hymns, and still send former Taichang craftsmen to teach the Kong clan youths for the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on guihai of the fourth month, the court ordered: "Now that the Qufu temple of the Fulfilling Sage is finished, give the Duke of Fulfilling the Sage and the three offering officers ritual robes and a set of ascent hymns, and send former Taichang craftsmen to train Kong family youths for the rites.

sentences.zh: 」甲子，以尚書左丞烏林答願為平章政事，右丞夾谷衡為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: " On jiazi Left Vice Director Ulinada Yuan was made participation councillor; Right Vice Director Jiagu Heng was made left vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiazi Left Vice Director Ulinada Yuan was appointed participation councillor, and Right Vice Director Jiagu Heng left vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸玉泉山。

translations.literal: On bingzi he went to Jade Spring Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he went to Jade Spring Mountain.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以修河防工畢，參知政事胥持國進官二階，翰林待制奧屯忠孝以下三十六人各一階，獲嘉令王維翰以下五十六人各賜銀弊有差。

translations.literal: On wuyin, because river-defense works were complete, Participation Councillor Xu Chiguo was promoted two ranks; thirty-six men including Hanlin awaiting appointment Aotun Zhongxiao each one rank; and fifty-six men including Huojia magistrate Wang Weihan each received silver and silk rewards in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, with the river works finished, Participation Councillor Xu Chiguo was raised two ranks; thirty-six officials including Hanlin awaiting appointment Aotun Zhongxiao each one rank; and fifty-six men including Huojia Magistrate Wang Weihan each received graded awards of silver and silk.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以尚書右丞相來谷清臣為左丞相，監修國史，封密國公。

translations.literal: On gengchen Right Chancellor Jiagu Qingchen was made left chancellor, overseer of the national history, and enfeoffed as Duke of Mi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Right Chancellor Jiagu Qingchen became left chancellor, overseer of the national history, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Mi.

sentences.zh: 樞密使襄為尚書右丞相，封任國公。

translations.literal: Bureau of Military Affairs head Xiang was made right chancellor and enfeoffed as Duke of Ren.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau of Military Affairs Head Xiang was appointed right chancellor and enfeoffed as Duke of Ren.

sentences.zh: 參知政事胥持國為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Xu Chiguo was made right vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Participation Councillor Xu Chiguo was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賜宰臣手詔，以風俗不淳，官吏苟且，責之。

translations.literal: On renwu the chancellors were given an imperial handwritten edict rebuking them because customs were not pure and officials were lax.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the chancellors received a handwritten imperial rebuke: popular morals were coarse and officials were slipshod.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，命減萬甯宮陳設九十四所。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on bingxu, ninety-four display settings at Wanning Palace were ordered reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingxu, ninety-four display settings at Wanning Palace were cut.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以出師，遣禮部尚書張暐告於廟社。

translations.literal: On xinmao, because troops were being sent out, Minister of Rites Zhang Wei was dispatched to report at the altars of state and soil.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, with an army taking the field, Minister of Rites Zhang Wei was sent to announce it at the altars of state and soil.

sentences.zh: 乙未，判平陽府事鎬王永中以罪賜死，並及二子，丁酉，詔中外。

translations.literal: On yiwei Prince Hao Yongzhong, who was administering Pingyang prefecture, was sentenced to death for his crimes, together with his two sons; on dingyou an edict was issued throughout inner and outer circles.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Prince Hao Yongzhong, acting prefect of Pingyang, was put to death for his crimes along with his two sons; on dingyou the court proclaimed this throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔諸路猛安謀克農隙講武，本路提刑司察其惰者罰之。

translations.literal: On yisi an edict ordered meng’an-mouke on every circuit to drill in martial arts during farming slack; the circuit Judicial Inspection Commission was to punish the lazy.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the court ordered meng’an-mouke on all circuits to drill during farming slack, with each circuit’s Judicial Inspection Commission to punish slackness.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命左丞相來谷清臣行省於臨潢府。

translations.literal: On gengxu Left Chancellor Jiagu Qingchen was ordered to conduct provincial administration at Linhuang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Left Chancellor Jiagu Qingchen was sent to administer affairs at Linhuang.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰，右諫議大夫賈守謙、右拾遺僕散訛可坐鎬王永中事奏對不實，削官二階，罷之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingchen Right Remonstrance Officer Jia Shouqian and Right Remonstrance Supplicator Pusan Woke, for giving untrue testimony in the Prince Hao Yongzhong affair, had two ranks stripped and were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingchen, Right Remonstrance Officer Jia Shouqian and Right Remonstrance Supplicator Pusan Woke were demoted two ranks and removed for false testimony in the Prince Hao Yongzhong case.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞孫即康，右補闕蒙括胡剌、右拾遺田仲禮各罰金二十斤。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Sun Jikang, Right Supplementation Officer Mengkuo Hula, and Right Remonstrance Supplicator Tian Zhongli were each fined twenty jin.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Sun Jikang, Right Supplementation Officer Mengkuo Hula, and Right Remonstrance Supplicator Tian Zhongli were each fined twenty jin.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以樞密副使唐括貢為樞密使。

translations.literal: On bingyin Bureau of Military Affairs Vice Commissioner Tangguo Gong was made bureau head.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Bureau of Military Affairs Vice Commissioner Tangguo Gong was appointed bureau head.

sentences.zh: 以久雨，鋋。

translations.literal: Because of prolonged rain, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Because of prolonged rain, court audiences were suspended.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太白經天。

translations.literal: On gengchen Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，左丞相清臣遣使來獻捷。

translations.literal: On xinsi Left Chancellor Qingchen sent envoys to present a victory report.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Left Chancellor Qingchen sent envoys bearing news of victory.

sentences.zh: 七月丙申，幸曹王永升第。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on bingchen he visited the Prince of Cao Yong Sheng’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingchen, he visited the residence of the Prince of Cao, Yong Sheng.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，始定文武官六貫石以上、承應人並及廕者、若在籍儒生章服制。

translations.literal: On jiachen regulations were first set for ceremonial dress for civil and military officials receiving six guan of grain and above, attendants and their enfeoffed heirs, and registered Confucian students.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the court first fixed regalia for civil and military officials paid six guan of grain or more, for attendants and their enfeoffed heirs, and for registered Confucian students.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，命袞州長官以曲阜新修廟告成于宣聖。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiwei the Yanzhou chief administrator was ordered to report completion of the newly repaired Confucius temple to the Fulfilling Sage.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiwei, the Yanzhou chief administrator was ordered to announce completion of the newly repaired Confucius temple to the Fulfilling Sage.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，至自萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On guihai he returned from Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he returned from Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以溫敦伯英言，命禮部令學官講經。

translations.literal: On jisi, at Wendun Boying’s suggestion, the Ministry of Rites was ordered to have academy instructors lecture on the classics.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, on Wendun Boying’s advice, the Ministry of Rites was told to have school officers expound the classics.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以吏部尚書吳鼎樞等賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: On xinwei Minister of Personnel Wu Dingshu and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Minister of Personnel Wu Dingshu and others were sent to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 壬申，行省都事獨吉永中來報捷。

translations.literal: On renshen Provincial Commission chief clerk Duji Yongzhong came bearing news of victory.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Duji Yongzhong, chief clerk of the provincial commission, arrived with a victory report.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，敕宮中承應人出職後三年內犯贓罪者，元舉官連坐，不在去官之限，著為令。

translations.literal: On yihai an edict: palace attendants who within three years after leaving office commit graft crimes—the official who originally recommended them shares punishment, not limited by having left office; this was made a statute.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict ruled that if a palace attendant committed graft within three years of leaving office, the official who had recommended him would be punished jointly, even after leaving his post; this was written into law.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，木波進馬。

translations.literal: On xinsi the Mubo presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the Mubo presented horses.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午朔，天壽節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on renwu, Heavenly Longevity Festival: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, new moon on renwu, the Heavenly Longevity Festival: envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia came with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 甲申，冊靜寧山神為鎮安公，忽土白山神為瑞聖公。

translations.literal: On jiashen the spirit of Jingning Mountain was enfeoffed as Lord Pacifying the Realm, and the spirit of Hutubai Mountain as Lord Auspicious Sage.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the god of Jingning Mountain was enfeoffed as Lord Pacifying the Realm and the god of Hutubai Mountain as Lord Auspicious Sage.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，知河間府事移剌仲方為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On bingxu Acting Hejian Prefect Yila Zhongfang was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Yila Zhongfang, acting prefect of Hejian, was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，如秋山。

translations.literal: On xinmao he went to Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he went to Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左司郎中粘割胡上為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Left Secretariat bureau director Nianhe Hushang was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Nianhe Hushang, left secretariat bureau director, was sent as birthday envoy to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，至自秋山。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingchen he returned from Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, tenth month, on bingchen he returned from Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以歲幸春水、秋山，五日一進起居表，自今可十日一進。

translations.literal: On dingsi, because of the annual tours to the spring waters and Autumn Mountain, audience memorials had been submitted every five days; from now on they could be submitted every ten days.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, with the yearly visits to the spring waters and Autumn Mountain, memorials on the emperor’s well-being had been sent every five days; henceforth they could be sent every ten.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命尚書左丞來谷衡行省於撫州，命選親軍、武衛軍各五百人以從，仍給錢五千萬。

translations.literal: On yihai Left Secretariat Vice Director Jiagu Heng was ordered to conduct a provincial commission at Fuzhou; five hundred men each from the personal guard and military guard were selected to accompany him, and fifty million in cash was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Left Secretariat Vice Director Jiagu Heng was sent to administer a provincial commission at Fuzhou, with five hundred men each from the personal guard and military guard chosen to follow and fifty million in cash provided.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，左丞相夾谷清臣罷，右丞相襄代領行省事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on wuzi Left Chancellor Jiagu Qingchen was dismissed; Right Chancellor Xiang took over the provincial commission in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuzi, Left Chancellor Jiagu Qingchen left office and Right Chancellor Xiang assumed the provincial commission.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以刑部尚書紇石烈貞等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On bingshen Minister of Punishments Heseli Zhen and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Minister of Punishments Heseli Zhen and others were sent to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，初定猛安謀克鎮邊後放免者授官格。

translations.literal: On renyin regulations were first set for office grants to meng’an-mouke released after garrisoning the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the court first fixed ranks for meng’an-mouke demobilized after frontier garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 禁射糧軍，應役但成隊伍，不得持兵器及凡可以傷人者。

translations.literal: Transport-archer troops were forbidden: on corvée they were only to form ranks and might not carry weapons or anything that could injure people.
translations.idiomatic: Grain-transport archer troops were barred from carrying weapons or anything that could wound while on duty; they were to march only in formation.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，報敗敵於望雲。

translations.literal: On jiachen defeat of the enemy at Wangyun was reported.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen a report came of victory over the enemy at Wangyun.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以樞密使唐括貢、御史大夫移剌仲方、禮部尚書張暐等二十三人充計議官，凡軍事則議之。

translations.literal: On yisi Bureau of Military Affairs head Tangguo Gong, Censor-in-Chief Yila Zhongfang, Minister of Rites Zhang Wei, and twenty others in all were made planning officers; all military matters were to be deliberated by them.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Tangguo Gong, bureau of military affairs head, Yila Zhongfang as censor-in-chief, Zhang Wei as minister of rites, and twenty others were named planning officers to deliberate all military affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊申，初定縣官增水田升除制。

translations.literal: On wushen regulations were first set for county officials’ promotion and demotion based on increased irrigated fields.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the court first set rules for promoting or demoting county magistrates according to added irrigated land.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，詔招撫北邊軍民。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on yimao, an edict ordered winning over northern border troops and people.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao, an edict called for pacifying northern frontier soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 以知登聞檢院賈益為高麗生日使，戶部員外郎納蘭昉為橫賜使。

translations.literal: Registrar of the Office for Hearing Memorials Jia Yi was made Goryeo birthday envoy; Ministry of Revenue section vice director Nalan Fang was made cross-bestowal envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Yi of the Office for Hearing Memorials was sent as birthday envoy to Goryeo, and Nalan Fang, section vice director of the Ministry of Revenue, as cross-bestowal envoy.

sentences.zh: 戊午，禮部尚書張暐等進《大金儀禮》。

translations.literal: On wuwu Minister of Rites Zhang Wei and others presented the Rites of the Great Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Minister of Rites Zhang Wei and others presented the Rites of the Great Jin.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，應奉翰林文字趙秉文上書論奸欺。

translations.literal: On dingmao Palace Hanlin literary officer Zhao Bingwen memorialized on fraud and deception.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Zhao Bingwen, palace Hanlin literary officer, submitted a memorial on fraud and deceit.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔加五鎮四瀆王爵。

translations.literal: On yihai an edict added princely ranks to the Five Marchmounts and Four Watercourses.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict raised the noble ranks of the Five Marchmounts and Four Watercourses.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上幸後園閱軍器。

translations.literal: On gengchen the emperor visited the rear garden to review weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the emperor went to the rear garden to inspect arms.

sentences.zh: 是月，右丞相襄率駙馬都尉僕散揆等進軍大鹽濼，分兵攻取諸營。

translations.literal: That month Right Chancellor Xiang led Imperial Son-in-law Commandant Pusan Hui and others in an advance on Dayan Marsh, dividing forces to capture the various camps.
translations.idiomatic: That month Right Chancellor Xiang, with Imperial Son-in-law Commandant Pusan Hui and others, marched on Dayan Marsh and split the army to take the camps one by one.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，命有司祀高禖如新儀。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiazi, the relevant offices were ordered to sacrifice to the High Matron by the new rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiazi, officials were ordered to offer the High Matron sacrifice according to the new ritual.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，右丞相襄、左丞衡至自軍前。

translations.literal: On dingmao Right Chancellor Xiang and Left Vice Director Heng arrived from the army front.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Right Chancellor Xiang and Left Vice Director Heng returned from the front.

sentences.zh: 己巳，複命還軍。

translations.literal: On jisi they were again ordered to return to the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi they were ordered back to the army.

sentences.zh: 幸都南行宮春水。

translations.literal: He went to the southern traveling palace for the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: He went to the southern traveling palace for the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，至自行宮。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he returned from the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he returned from the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 是月，初造虎符發兵。

translations.literal: That month tiger tallies for dispatching troops were first made.
translations.idiomatic: That month tiger tallies for issuing troops were first cast.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: Third month, on dingyou, he went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingyou, he went to Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 不雨，遣宮望祭嶽鎮海瀆於北郊。

translations.literal: For lack of rain, palace observation sacrifices to the marchmounts, river gods, and sea gods were sent to the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: With no rain falling, the court sent palace officers to perform distant sacrifices to the marchmounts, rivers, and seas at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，敕尚書省：「刑獄雖已奏行，其間恐有疑枉，其再議以聞。

translations.literal: On guimao the Secretariat was commanded: "Although criminal cases have already been reported for execution, among them there may be doubt and wrongful judgment; deliberate again and report.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Secretariat was told: "Even when a criminal case has been reported for execution, it may still hold doubt or error; review it again and report.

sentences.zh: 人命至重，不可不慎也。

translations.literal: Human life is of the utmost weight; it cannot be treated carelessly.
translations.idiomatic: A human life weighs more than anything else; it must not be handled rashly.

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，遣參知政事尼厖古鑒祈雨於社稷。

translations.literal: " On jiachen Participation Councillor Nimoguchu Jian was sent to pray for rain at the altars of state and grain.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiachen Participation Councillor Nimoguchu Jian was dispatched to pray for rain at the state and grain altars.

sentences.zh: 丁未，複遣使就祈雨于東嶽。

translations.literal: On dingwei envoys were again sent to pray for rain at the Eastern Marchmount.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei envoys were again sent to pray for rain at the Eastern Marchmount.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，命尚書右丞胥持國祈雨於太廟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinhai Right Secretariat Vice Director Xu Chiguo was ordered to pray for rain at the Royal Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, on xinhai, Right Secretariat Vice Director Xu Chiguo was sent to pray for rain at the Royal Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣使審決冤獄。

translations.literal: On renzi envoys were dispatched to review and decide wrongful imprisonment cases.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi envoys were sent to examine and settle cases of wrongful imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 京城禁傘扇。

translations.literal: In the capital, parasols and fans were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Parasols and fans were banned in the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊午，初行區種法，民十五以上、六十以下有土田者，丁種一畝。

translations.literal: On wuwu the zone-field planting law was first implemented: commoners between fifteen and sixty who held farmland were to plant one mu per household head.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the zone-field law took effect: every man between fifteen and sixty who owned land was to plant one mu per household.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命御史大夫移剌仲方祈雨於社稷。

translations.literal: On yichou Censor-in-Chief Yila Zhongfang was ordered to pray for rain at the altars of state and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Censor-in-Chief Yila Zhongfang was sent to pray for rain at the state and grain altars.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命參知政事馬琪祈雨於太廟。

translations.literal: On renshen Participation Councillor Ma Qi was ordered to pray for rain at the Royal Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Participation Councillor Ma Qi was sent to pray for rain at the Royal Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，尚書省以趙承元言，請追上孝孝懿皇太后冊寶，然後行諡冊禮。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Secretariat, on Zhao Chengyuan’s proposal, asked to posthumously bestow seals and regalia on the Filially Pious and Kindly Honored Empress Dowager Xiaoyi before conducting the posthumous-title rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, at Zhao Chengyuan’s urging, the Secretariat asked to restore seals and regalia to the late Filially Pious and Kindly Honored Empress Dowager Xiaoyi before holding the posthumous investiture.

sentences.zh: 禮官執奏尊皇太后已詔示中外，無追冊禮，從之。

translations.literal: Ritual officials insisted that the honored empress dowager had already been proclaimed within and without the court, so there was no rite of retrospective investiture; the court agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officers argued that the empress dowager had already been honored by edict throughout the realm and needed no posthumous investiture; the emperor accepted their view.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上以久不雨，命禮部尚書張暐祈於北嶽。

translations.literal: On wuyin, because rain had long been lacking, the emperor ordered Minister of Rites Zhang Wei to pray at the Northern Marchmount.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, with drought lingering, the emperor sent Minister of Rites Zhang Wei to pray at the Northern Marchmount.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣官望祭嶽鎮海瀆於北郊。

translations.literal: On jimao officials were sent for observation sacrifices to the marchmounts, river gods, and sea gods at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao officials were sent to perform distant sacrifices to the marchmounts, rivers, and seas at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰朔，觀稼於近郊，因閱區田。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on gengchen: he viewed the crops in the nearby suburbs and reviewed the zone fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the gengchen new moon, he inspected the harvest in the suburbs near the capital and reviewed the zone-field plots.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以久旱，徙市。

translations.literal: On yiyou, because of prolonged drought, the markets were relocated.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, because of prolonged drought, the markets were moved.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔複市如常。

translations.literal: On gengyin an edict restored the markets as usual.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the court ordered the markets restored to normal.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以尚藥局副使粘割忠為橫賜夏國使。

translations.literal: On renchen Imperial Pharmacy Bureau vice commissioner Niege Zhong was made cross-bestowal envoy to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Niege Zhong, vice commissioner of the Imperial Pharmacy Bureau, was sent as envoy bearing cross-border gifts to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 乙未，參知政事尼厖古鑒薨。

translations.literal: On yiwei Participation Councillor Nimoguchu Jian died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Participation Councillor Nimoguchu Jian died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，雨足。
