translations.literal: On gengzi the rain was sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the rains were adequate.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，上以百姓艱食，詔出倉粟十萬石減價以糶之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiaxu: because the people had scarce food, an edict released a hundred thousand shi of granary grain to be sold at reduced price.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, with the people short of food, the court ordered a hundred thousand shi of state grain sold at reduced price.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，平晉縣民利通家蠶自成綿段，長七尺一寸五分，闊四尺九寸，詔賜絹十匹。

translations.literal: On yichou, at Pingjin county commoner Litong’s household silkworms by themselves formed a cotton-wool section seven chi one cun five fen long and four chi nine cun wide; an edict granted ten bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou silkworms at the home of Litong, a commoner in Pingjin county, spontaneously formed a cotton-wool length seven chi one cun five fen long and four chi nine cun wide; the court awarded ten bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，敕自今長老、大師、大德不限年甲，長老、大師許度弟子三人，大德二人，戒僧年四十以上者度一人。

translations.literal: On dingmao an edict: from now on elders, grand masters, and great virtues are not limited by age; elders and grand masters may ordain three disciples each, great virtues two, and ordained monks forty years of age and above may ordain one.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the court ruled that from then on elders, grand masters, and great virtues were not bound by age limits: elders and grand masters might ordain three disciples each, great virtues two, and ordained monks aged forty or more one each.

sentences.zh: 其大定十五年附籍沙彌年六十以上並令戒，仍不許度弟子。

translations.literal: Registered novice monks from the fifteenth year of Dading who were sixty or older were all to receive the precepts and were still not permitted to ordain disciples.
translations.idiomatic: Novice monks registered since the fifteenth year of Dading who were sixty or older were required to take the precepts but still could not ordain disciples.

sentences.zh: 尼、道士、女冠亦如之。

translations.literal: Nuns, Daoist priests, and female Daoists were likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same rule applied to nuns, Daoist priests, and female Daoists.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫移剌仲方罷。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Yelü Zhongfang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Yelü Zhongfang left office.

sentences.zh: 庚午，幸環秀亭觀稼。

translations.literal: On gengwu he visited Huanxiu Pavilion to view the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he went to Huanxiu Pavilion to inspect the harvest.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔應禁軍器路分，步弓手擬於射糧軍內選之，馬弓手擬于猛安謀克軍戶余丁內選之。

translations.literal: On guiyou an edict: on routes where military weapons are prohibited, foot archers are to be chosen from the grain-shooting army and horse archers from surplus sons of meng’an-mouke military households.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the court ordered that on routes where private arms were banned, foot archers be drawn from the grain-shooting army and horse archers from spare sons of meng’an-mouke households.

sentences.zh: 其有為百姓害，從本州縣斷遣。

translations.literal: Those who harm the common people are to be judged and sentenced by their prefecture or county.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who harmed commoners was to be tried and punished by the local prefecture or county.

sentences.zh: 無猛安戶，於二百里內屯駐軍余丁內取之，依步弓手月給二貫石。

translations.literal: Where there is no meng’an household, men are to be taken from surplus sons of garrison troops stationed within two hundred li, paid like foot archers at two guan of grain per month.
translations.idiomatic: Where no meng’an household was available, recruits came from spare sons of nearby garrison troops within two hundred li, with the same monthly pay of two guan of grain as foot archers.

sentences.zh: 七月庚辰，禦紫宸殿，受諸王、百官賀，賜諸王、宰執酒。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on gengchen he held court at the Purple Felicity Hall, received congratulations from the princes and the hundred officials, and bestowed wine on the princes and the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on gengchen, he held audience at the Purple Felicity Hall, received congratulations from the princes and officials, and gave wine to the princes and chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 敕有司：「以酒萬尊置通衢，賜民縱飲。

translations.literal: He instructed the relevant offices: "Place ten thousand jars of wine on the main thoroughfares and grant the people free drinking.
translations.idiomatic: He told the relevant offices, "Set ten thousand jars of wine along the main roads and let the people drink freely.

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，敕今後高麗、夏使入見數奏，令新設各國通事具公服與閣門使上殿監聽。

translations.literal: " On yiyou an edict: hereafter when Goryeo and Xia envoys present memorials at audience, the newly established interpreters for each state, in full court dress, are to ascend the hall with the gate commissioners to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: " On yiyou the court ordered that when Goryeo and Western Xia envoys presented memorials at audience, the new state interpreters, in formal court dress, were to go up the hall with the gate commissioners to oversee the proceedings.

sentences.zh: 命有司收瘞西北路陣亡骸骨。

translations.literal: He ordered the relevant offices to collect and bury the bones of those killed in battle on the Northwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered officials to gather and inter the remains of soldiers killed on the Northwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiyou he hunted in the nearby suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou, he hunted in the suburbs near the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，幸玉泉山。

translations.literal: On guichou he went to Jade Spring Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he went to Jade Spring Mountain.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以郊祀日期詔中外。

translations.literal: On jiazi the date of the suburban sacrifice was announced within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the date of the suburban sacrifice was proclaimed to court and realm.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，至自萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On wuchen he returned from Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he returned from Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 以陝西西北路轉運使董師中為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Shaanxi and Northwest Circuit transport commissioner Dong Shizhong was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Shizhong, transport commissioner of the Shaanxi and Northwest circuits, was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，左丞衡丁父憂。

translations.literal: On guiyou Left Vice Director Heng entered mourning for his father.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Left Vice Director Heng began mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑朔，天壽節，宋、高、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on dingchou: the Heavenly Longevity Festival; Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingchou new moon, the Heavenly Longevity Festival: envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia came to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 幸天長觀。

translations.literal: He visited the Eternal Heaven Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: He visited the Eternal Heaven Abbey.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以右丞相襄為左丞相，監修國史，封常山郡王。

translations.literal: On xinsi Right Chancellor Xiang was made left chancellor, overseer of the national history, and enfeoffed as Duke of Changshan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Right Chancellor Xiang became left chancellor, overseer of the national history, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Changshan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賜襄酒百尊。

translations.literal: On renywu Xiang was granted a hundred jars of wine.
translations.idiomatic: On renywu Xiang was given a hundred jars of wine.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 癸未，都人進酒三千一百瓶，詔以賜北邊軍吏。

translations.literal: On guiwei the people of the capital presented three thousand one hundred bottles of wine; an edict granted them to northern border officers.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the capital populace presented three thousand one hundred bottles of wine; the court ordered them given to officers on the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書張嗣等為賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Zhang Si and others were made Song birthday envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Zhang Si and others were sent as envoys bearing birthday gifts to Song.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，左丞衡起複。

translations.literal: On guisi Left Vice Director Heng was recalled from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Left Vice Director Heng was recalled from mourning duty.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，知大興府卜、同知郭鑄以擅逮問宰臣，各笞四十。

translations.literal: On dingyou Daxing prefect Bu and Vice Prefect Guo Zhuo, for arresting and questioning chancellors on their own authority, were each flogged forty strokes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Daxing Prefect Bu and Vice Prefect Guo Zhuo were each beaten forty strokes for summoning and questioning chancellors without authority.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，西南路招討使僕散揆至自軍。

translations.literal: On xinchou Southwest Circuit Pacification Commissioner Pusan Kan returned from the army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Southwest Circuit Pacification Commissioner Pusan Kan returned from campaign.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以國子監丞烏古論達吉不為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On yisi Guozijian vice director Wugulun Dajibu was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Guozijian Vice Director Wugulun Dajibu was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午朔，詔選親軍八百人戍撫州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on bingwu: an edict selected eight hundred personal guards to garrison Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the bingwu new moon of the tenth month, the court chose eight hundred personal guards to garrison Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命左丞相襄行省于北京，簽書樞密院事完顏匡行院於撫州。

translations.literal: On gengxu Left Chancellor Xiang was ordered to conduct provincial administration at Beijing; Privy Council signatory Wanyan Kuang was ordered to conduct provincial administration at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Left Chancellor Xiang was sent to administer affairs at Beijing, and Privy Council signatory Wanyan Kuang to administer affairs at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，祫享於太廟。

translations.literal: On bingchen the joint autumn offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the collating autumn rite was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，參知政事馬琪罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on wuzi Participation Councillor Ma Qi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuzi, Participation Councillor Ma Qi left office.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，特滿群牧契丹陀鎖、德壽反，泰州軍擊敗之。

translations.literal: On gengyin Khitan Tuo Suo and De Shou of the Special Full Herds Office rebelled; the Taizhou army defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Khitan Tuo Suo and De Shou of the Special Full Herds Office rose in revolt and were defeated by the Taizhou army.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫董師中、北京留守裔並為參知政事。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Dong Shizhong and Beijing intendant Yi were both made participation councillors.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Dong Shizhong and Beijing intendant Yi were both appointed participation councillors.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以陝西路統軍使崇道等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On jiawu Shaanxi Circuit commander Chongdao and others were made Song New Year envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Shaanxi Circuit Commander Chongdao and others were sent as Song New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，朝享於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingyou the morning audience offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the morning court sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，有事於南郊，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On wuxu the southern suburb rite was performed, a great amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the southern suburb sacrifice was held, a general amnesty was issued, and the reign era was changed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，曹王永升率親王、百官賀。

translations.literal: On jihai the Prince of Cao, Yong Sheng, led the princes and the hundred officials in congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Prince of Cao, Yong Sheng, led the princes and officials in offering congratulations.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命有司祈雪，仍遣官祈于東嶽。

translations.literal: On guimao he ordered the relevant offices to pray for snow and still dispatched officials to pray at the Eastern Peak.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he ordered officials to pray for snow and also sent envoys to pray at the Eastern Peak.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，樞密使唐括貢率百官請上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on bingwu Privy Council Commissioner Tangguo Gong led the hundred officials in requesting an honorific title; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingwu, Privy Council Commissioner Tangguo Gong led the officials in asking that an honorific title be accepted; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遣提點太醫近侍局使李仁惠勞賜北邊將士，授官者萬一千人，授賞者幾二萬人，凡用銀二十萬兩，絹五萬匹、錢三十二貫。

translations.literal: On yiyou Commissioner of the Palace Medical Attendant Bureau Li Renhui was dispatched to comfort and reward northern border officers and soldiers; those given office appointments numbered eleven thousand, those given rewards nearly twenty thousand; in all two hundred thousand taels of silver, fifty thousand bolts of silk, and thirty-two strings of cash were used.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Li Renhui, commissioner of the Palace Medical Attendant Bureau, was sent to comfort and reward northern frontier troops; eleven thousand men received appointments and nearly twenty thousand received gifts, at a cost of two hundred thousand taels of silver, fifty thousand bolts of silk, and thirty-two strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以同知登聞檢院阿不罕德剛為高麗國生日使，壬子，樞密使唐括貢複率百官請上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: On gengxu Abuhan Degang, associate administrator of the Petitions and Memorials Inspection Court, was made Goryeo birthday envoy; on renzi Military Affairs Commissioner Tangguo Gong again led the hundred officials to ask for an honorific title; not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Abuhan Degang, associate administrator of the Petitions and Memorials Inspection Court, was sent as Goryeo birthday envoy; on renzi Military Affairs Commissioner Tangguo Gong again led the hundred officials to request an honorific title; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙亥朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring, first month, on yihai the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2, on the yihai new moon of the first spring month, congratulatory envoys came from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，敕職官犯贓私不得訴於同官。

translations.literal: On yiyou an edict ruled that officials guilty of private graft might not appeal to colleagues in the same office.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou an edict ruled that officials guilty of private graft might not appeal to colleagues in the same office.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，如安州春水。

translations.literal: On dinghai he went to Anzhou for the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he went to Anzhou for the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，至自春水。

translations.literal: On dingyou he returned from the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he returned from the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，宋主以母后喪，遣使告哀。

translations.literal: On xinchou the Song ruler, because of his mother’s mourning, sent envoys to announce the bereavement.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, with his mother in mourning, the Song ruler sent envoys to announce the bereavement.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，敕自今職官犯贓，每削一官殿一年。

translations.literal: Second month, on dingsi an edict ruled that from now on, when officials committed graft, each rank stripped would bring one year of demotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingsi, the court ruled that from then on each rank stripped for graft would carry one year of demotion.

sentences.zh: 是日，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: That day, Venus was seen in daytime and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: That day Venus was visible by day and crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 是月，特命襲封衍聖公孔元措世襲兼曲阜令。

translations.literal: That month, Kong Yuancuo was specially ordered to inherit as Hereditary Duke of Deriving the Sage and concurrently hold the magistracy of Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Kong Yuancuo was specially ordered to inherit as Hereditary Duke of Deriving the Sage and to serve concurrently as magistrate of Qufu.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，親王、百官複請上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: Third month, on jimao imperial princes and the hundred officials again asked for an honorific title; not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jimao, imperial princes and the hundred officials again requested an honorific title; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命尚書戶部侍郎溫昉佩金符，行六部尚書于撫州。

translations.literal: On renwu Wen Fang, vice director of the Households Ministry, was ordered to wear the gold tally and act as director of the six ministries at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Wen Fang, vice director of the Households Ministry, was ordered to wear the gold tally and serve as acting head of the six ministries at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，幸西園閱軍器。

translations.literal: On gengyin he visited the Western Garden to review weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he visited the Western Garden to inspect arms.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，始定保舉德行才能格。

translations.literal: On xinmao standards for recommending virtue and talent were first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao standards for recommending virtue and talent were first set.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，平章政事烏林答願罷。

translations.literal: On guisi Participation Councillor Ulinada Yuan left office.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Participation Councillor Ulinada Yuan left office.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，樞密使唐括貢率百官請上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: On dingyou Military Affairs Commissioner Tangguo Gong led the hundred officials to ask for an honorific title; not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Military Affairs Commissioner Tangguo Gong led the hundred officials to request an honorific title; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 以參知政事裔代左丞相襄行省于北京。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Yi replaced Left Chancellor Xiang in conducting route-provincial affairs at Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: Participation Councillor Yi replaced Left Chancellor Xiang in administering the Beijing route-province.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiayin he went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on jiayin of the fourth month, he went to Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命有司祈雨，望祭嶽鎮海瀆於北郊。

translations.literal: On bingchen the relevant offices were ordered to pray for rain and to perform distant sacrifice to the mountains, rivers, and seas at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the court ordered officials to pray for rain and to offer distant sacrifice to the mountains, rivers, and seas at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 甲子，祈雨於社稷。

translations.literal: On jiazi rain prayers were offered at the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi rain prayers were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 尚書省奏：「比歲北邊調度頗多，請降僧道空名度牒紫褐師德號以助軍儲。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: “In recent years frontier requisitions have been heavy; we ask to sell empty-name ordination certificates, purple-brown clerical robes, and master virtue titles to help military stores.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat memorialized: “Frontier levies have been heavy in recent years; we ask to sell empty-name ordination certificates, purple-brown robes, and master virtue titles to bolster military stores.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ” Approved.
translations.idiomatic: ” The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，親王宣敕始用女直字。

translations.literal: On guiyou imperial princes’ proclamations of appointment first used Jurchen script.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou imperial princes’ appointment edicts were first issued in Jurchen script.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌朔，諭宰臣曰：「比以軍須，隨路賦調。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiaxu the new moon, he instructed the chief ministers: “Lately, because of military needs, levies have been assigned route by route.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiaxu new moon, he told the chief ministers: “Lately, because of military needs, levies have been assigned route by route.

sentences.zh: 司縣不度緩急，促期征斂，使民費及數倍，胥吏又乘之以侵暴。

translations.literal: The prefectures and districts did not weigh urgency and slack, pressed collection on a short schedule, and made the people pay several times the proper amount; clerks also took advantage to oppress and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and districts did not weigh what was urgent or could wait, pressed collection on short deadlines, and made the people pay several times the proper sum; clerks also used the chance to extort and plunder.

sentences.zh: 其令提刑司究察之。

translations.literal: Let the Judicial Inspection Commission investigate this thoroughly.”
translations.idiomatic: Let the Judicial Inspection Commission investigate this thoroughly.”

sentences.zh: 」丙子，集官吏于尚書省，詔諭之曰：「今紀綱不立，官吏弛慢，遷延苟簡，習以成弊。

translations.literal: On bingzi officials were assembled at the Secretariat, and he instructed them: “Now discipline is not established and officials are lax, delaying and taking the easy way until it has become a chronic abuse.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi officials were assembled at the Secretariat and he told them: “Discipline is not established and officials are lax, delaying and taking shortcuts until it has become a chronic abuse.

sentences.zh: 職官多以吉善求名，計得自安，國家何賴焉？

translations.literal: Many in office seek a good name by lucky words, scheming only to keep themselves safe—on what can the state rely?
translations.idiomatic: Many in office seek a good name with lucky words and scheme only to keep themselves safe—what can the state rely on?

sentences.zh: 至於徇情賣法，省部令史尤甚。

translations.literal: As for bending the law for private favor, the Secretariat clerks are worst of all.
translations.idiomatic: As for bending the law for private favor, the Secretariat clerks are worst of all.

sentences.zh: 尚書省其戒諭之。

translations.literal: Let the Secretariat warn and instruct them.”
translations.idiomatic: Let the Secretariat warn and instruct them.”

sentences.zh: 」丁丑，北京行省參知政事裔移駐臨潢府。

translations.literal: On dingchou Beijing Route participation councillor Yi moved his headquarters to Linhuangfu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Participation Councillor Yi of the Beijing Route moved his headquarters to Linhuangfu.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，升撫州為鎮寧軍。

translations.literal: On gengchen Fuzhou was promoted to Zhenning Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Fuzhou was promoted to Zhenning Army.

sentences.zh: 以雨足，報祭於社稷。

translations.literal: Because rain was sufficient, thanksgiving sacrifice was reported at the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Because rain had been sufficient, thanksgiving was reported at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 甲申，望祭嶽鎮海瀆於北郊。

translations.literal: On jiashen distant sacrifice to the mountains, rivers, and seas was performed at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen distant sacrifice to the mountains, rivers, and seas was performed at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，左丞相襄詣臨潢府。

translations.literal: On dinghai Left Chancellor Xiang went to Linhuangfu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Left Chancellor Xiang went to Linhuangfu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，皇子生，庚寅，詔中外，降死罪，釋徒以下。

translations.literal: On jichou a prince was born; on gengyin an edict was issued throughout the realm, commuting death sentences and releasing convicts below penal servitude.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou a prince was born; on gengyin an edict went throughout the realm, commuting death sentences and releasing convicts below penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，命禮部尚書張暐報祀高禖。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on yimao Minister of Rites Zhang Wei was ordered to report sacrifice at the Gao Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yimao, Minister of Rites Zhang Wei was ordered to report sacrifice at the Gao Shrine.

sentences.zh: 丙午，雨雹。

translations.literal: On bingwu hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu hail fell.

sentences.zh: 戌申，以澄州刺史王遵古為翰林直學士，仍敕無與選述，入直則奏聞，或霖雨，免入直，以遵古年老，且嘗侍講讀也。

translations.literal: On wushen Chengzhou prefect Wang Zungu was made Hanlin direct academician, and was also ordered not to take part in selection and posting; when entering duty he was to report to the throne, and in heavy rain he might be excused from entering duty—because Zungu was old and had once served as lecturer at court.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Wang Zungu, prefect of Chengzhou, was made Hanlin direct academician and also ordered not to take part in selection and posting; when on duty he was to report to the throne, and in heavy rain he might be excused from duty—because Zungu was elderly and had once served as lecturer at court.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔罷瑤光殿工作。

translations.literal: On gengxu an edict halted work on Yaoguang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu an edict halted work on Yaoguang Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，置全州盤安軍節度使，治安豐縣。

translations.literal: On jiayin Pan’an Army command was established at Quanzhou, administering Anfeng county.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Pan’an Army was established at Quanzhou, administering Anfeng county.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，封皇子為壽王。

translations.literal: On yimao the prince was enfeoffed as Prince Shou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the prince was enfeoffed as Prince Shou.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲午，出西橫門觀稼。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on jiawu he went out the Western Crossbar Gate to view the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiawu, he went out the Western Crossbar Gate to view the crops.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅朔，幸天長觀，建普天大醮，禁屠宰七日，無奏刑，百司權停決罰。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renyin the new moon, he visited Tianchang Abbey and established a Great Universal Offering; slaughter was forbidden for seven days, criminal reports were not received, and every office temporarily suspended sentencing.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the renyin new moon of the seventh month, he visited Tianchang Abbey and established a Great Universal Offering; slaughter was forbidden for seven days, criminal reports were not received, and every office temporarily suspended sentencing.

sentences.zh: 己未，命西上閣門使劉頍賜參知政事裔宴於行省。

translations.literal: On jiwei Western Upper Inner Gate commissioner Liu E was ordered to bestow a banquet on Participation Councillor Yi at the route-provincial headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Liu E, commissioner of the Western Upper Inner Gate, was ordered to give Participation Councillor Yi a banquet at the route-provincial headquarters.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，天壽節，禦紫宸殿受朝。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the Heavenly Longevity Festival, he held court at Zichen Hall and received congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the Heavenly Longevity Festival, he held audience at Zichen Hall and received congratulations.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，敕計議官所進奏帖，可直言利害，勿用浮辭。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on gengchen an edict instructed planning officers that memorial drafts submitted should state benefit and harm plainly and not use empty rhetoric.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengchen, planning officers were told that submitted memorial drafts should state benefit and harm plainly and not use empty rhetoric.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以邊事未寧，詔集六品以上官於尚書省，問攻守之計。

translations.literal: On xinsi, because the frontier was still unsettled, an edict assembled officials of the sixth rank and above at the Secretariat to ask their plans for attack and defense.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, with the frontier still unsettled, the court assembled officials of the sixth rank and above at the Secretariat to ask their plans for attack and defense.

sentences.zh: 應中外臣僚不以職位高下，或有方略材武，或長於調度，各舉三五人以備選用，無有顧望不盡所懷，期五日封章以進。

translations.literal: Whether inside or outside the court, regardless of rank, if anyone had strategy and martial talent or excelled at supply and deployment, each was to recommend three to five men for selection, without holding back for fear or favor; within five days sealed memorials were to be submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Whether inside or outside the court, regardless of rank, anyone with strategy and martial talent or skilled in supply and deployment was to recommend three to five men for selection, without holding back; within five days sealed memorials were to be submitted.

sentences.zh: 議者凡八十四人，言攻者五，守者四十六，且攻且守者三十三，召對睿思殿，論難久之。

translations.literal: Eighty-four men spoke; five favored attack, forty-six defense, and thirty-three both attack and defense; they were summoned to Ruosi Hall and debated at length.
translations.idiomatic: Eighty-four men spoke: five favored attack, forty-six defense, and thirty-three both; they were summoned to Ruosi Hall and debated at length.

sentences.zh: 癸未，至自萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On guiwei he returned from Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he returned from Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以左丞相襄為左副元帥，參知政事董師中尚書左丞，左宣徽使嵒尚書右丞，戶部尚書楊伯通參知政事。

translations.literal: On bingxu Left Chancellor Xiang was made left deputy marshal; Participation Councillor Dong Shizhong was made left vice director of the Secretariat; Left Palatial Intendant Yan was made right vice director of the Secretariat; and Minister of Revenue Yang Botong was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Left Chancellor Xiang was named left deputy marshal; Participation Councillor Dong Shizhong became left vice director of the Secretariat; Left Palatial Intendant Yan became right vice director of the Secretariat; and Minister of Revenue Yang Botong became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 尚書左丞夾穀衡罷。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Jiagu Heng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Jiagu Heng left office.

sentences.zh: 右丞胥持國致仕。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Xu Chiguo retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Director Xu Chiguo retired from office.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，參知政事裔罷。

translations.literal: On gengyin Participation Councillor Yi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Participation Councillor Yi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 樞密使唐括貢致仕。

translations.literal: Military Affairs Commissioner Tangguo Gong retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: Military Affairs Commissioner Tangguo Gong retired from office.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以左副元帥襄為樞密使兼平章政事。

translations.literal: On renchen Left Deputy Marshal Xiang was made military affairs commissioner and concurrent grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Left Deputy Marshal Xiang was appointed military affairs commissioner and concurrent grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑朔，天壽節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on xinchou the new moon, the Heavenly Longevity Festival; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinchou new moon, the Heavenly Longevity Festival: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，遣官分詣上京、東京、北京、咸平、臨潢、西京等路招募漢軍，不足則簽補之。

translations.literal: On renyin officials were dispatched separately to the routes of Shangjing, Eastern Capital, Beijing, Xianping, Linhuang, and Western Capital to recruit Han troops, and if the numbers fell short they were to be filled by conscription.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin envoys were sent to the Shangjing, Eastern Capital, Beijing, Xianping, Linhuang, and Western Capital routes to recruit Han troops, conscripting men if quotas were not met.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以夏使朝辭，詔答許複保安、蘭州榷場。

translations.literal: On yisi, as the Xia envoy took leave of court, an edict replied permitting the border markets at Bao’an and Lanzhou to reopen.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, when the Xia envoy took leave of court, the reply permitted the border markets at Bao’an and Lanzhou to reopen.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以知歸德府事完顏愈為賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: On dingwei Wanyan Yu, administrator of Guide Prefecture, was made Song birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Wanyan Yu, administrator of Guide Prefecture, was sent as envoy for Song’s imperial birthday.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以上京留守粘割斡特剌為平章政事。

translations.literal: On guichou Shangjing intendant Niecilie Wotela was made grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Niecilie Wotela, intendant of Shangjing, was appointed grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以樞密使兼平章政事襄，知大興府事胥持國為樞密副使、權參知政事，行省於北京。

translations.literal: On xinyou Military Affairs Commissioner and Grand Councilor Xiang, and Daxing prefect Xu Chiguo, were made deputy military affairs commissioner and acting participation councillor, respectively, to conduct route-provincial affairs at Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Military Affairs Commissioner and Grand Councilor Xiang, and Daxing Prefect Xu Chiguo, were made deputy military affairs commissioner and acting participation councillor, respectively, to administer the Beijing route-province.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，始置軍器監，掌治戎器，班少府監下，設甲坊、利器二署隸焉。

translations.literal: On yichou the Arms Works Directorate was first established to oversee weapons, ranking below the Court of Imperial Manufacturies, with an Armor Workshop and a Keen Weapons Office placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the Arms Works Directorate was first established to oversee weapons, ranking below the Court of Imperial Manufacturies, with an Armor Workshop and a Keen Weapons Office under its command.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，分遣官於東、西、北京，河北等路，中都二節鎮，買牛五萬頭。

translations.literal: On dingmao officials were dispatched separately to the Eastern Capital, Western Capital, and Beijing routes, Hebei and other routes, and the two superior prefectures of the central capital to buy fifty thousand head of cattle.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao envoys were sent to the Eastern and Western capitals, Beijing, Hebei, and other routes, and to the central capital’s two superior prefectures, to buy fifty thousand head of cattle.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午朔，初設講議所官十員，共議錢谷，以中都路轉運使孫鐸、戶部侍郎高汝礪等為之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengwu the new moon, ten Discussion Office posts were first established to deliberate on revenue and grain; Central Capital Route transport commissioner Sun Duo, Households vice director Gao Ruli, and others were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on the gengwu new moon, ten Discussion Office posts were first set up to deliberate on revenue and grain; Central Capital Route Transport Commissioner Sun Duo, Vice Director of the Households Ministry Gao Ruli, and others were named to them.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，尚書省奏，高麗國牒報，其王以老疾，令母弟𧦬權國事。

translations.literal: On gengchen the Secretariat reported that Goryeo’s memorial stated that its king, because of age and illness, had ordered his uterine younger brother Xi to exercise regency over state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Secretariat reported that Goryeo’s memorial said the king, aged and ill, had put his uterine younger brother Xi in charge of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬午，尚書省行推排。

translations.literal: On renwu the Secretariat carried out rank assessment.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Secretariat carried out rank assessment.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，皇子壽王薨。

translations.literal: On dinghai the prince, Prince Shou, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Prince Shou died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔獎諭西南路招討使僕散揆等有功將士。

translations.literal: On renchen an edict praised and instructed the meritorious officers and soldiers under Southwest Route pacification commissioner Pusan Kuai and others.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict praised and rewarded the meritorious officers and soldiers under Southwest Route Pacification Commissioner Pusan Kuai and others.

sentences.zh: 甲午，大雪，以米千石賜普濟院，令為粥以食貧民。

translations.literal: On jiawu heavy snow fell; a thousand shi of grain was given to the Universal Relief Courtyard and they were ordered to make porridge to feed the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu heavy snow fell; a thousand shi of grain was sent to the Universal Relief Courtyard with orders to cook porridge for the poor.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以禮部員外郎蒙括仁本為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On bingchen Mengkuo Renben, outer-office director of the Ministry of Rites, was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Mengkuo Renben, outer-office director of the Ministry of Rites, was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，冬至，有事於南郊。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiachen, the winter solstice, the southern suburb rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, the winter solstice, the southern suburb sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以薪貴，敕圍場地內無禁樵采。

translations.literal: On yisi, because firewood was costly, hunting enclosures were ordered not to forbid fuel gathering.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, because firewood was costly, fuel gathering was permitted within the hunting enclosures.

sentences.zh: 壬子，諭尚書省：「猛安謀克既不隸提刑司，宜令監察御史察其臧否。

translations.literal: On renzi he instructed the Secretariat: “Because meng’an-mouke do not fall under the Judicial Inspection Commission, supervising censors should investigate whether they are corrupt or upright.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he told the Secretariat, “Because meng’an-mouke are not under the Judicial Inspection Commission, supervising censors should investigate their conduct.

sentences.zh: 」庚申，北京留守裔以行省失職，杖一百，除名。

translations.literal: ” On gengshen Beijing intendant Yi, for dereliction in route-provincial duty, was beaten one hundred strokes and struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: ” On gengshen Beijing Intendant Yi, for failing in route-provincial duty, was beaten one hundred strokes and removed from office.

sentences.zh: 右諫議大夫納蘭昉杖九十，削官二階，罷之。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrance Officer Nalan Fang was beaten ninety strokes, stripped two ranks, and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrance Officer Nalan Fang was beaten ninety strokes, demoted two ranks, and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，諭宰臣曰：「朕居九重，民間難以遍知，宰相不見賓客，何以得知民間利害。」

translations.literal: On jiazi he instructed the chief ministers: “I dwell deep within the palace and cannot know the people everywhere; if the chief ministers do not receive guests, how can they learn the people’s benefit and harm?”
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he told the chief ministers, “I dwell deep within the palace and cannot know the people everywhere; if chief ministers do not receive guests, how will they learn what helps or harms the people?”

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳朔，敕御史台糾察諂佞趨走有實跡者。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jisi the new moon, the Censorate was ordered to investigate sycophants and runners whose fawning had real proof.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jisi new moon, the Censorate was ordered to investigate sycophants and runners whose fawning could be proved.

sentences.zh: 己卯，始鑄「承安寶貨」。

translations.literal: On jimao “Cheng’an Treasure Goods” were first cast.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the “Cheng’an Treasure Goods” coins were first cast.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣戶部侍郎上官瑜體究西京逃亡，勸率沿邊軍民耕種，戶部郎中李敬義規措臨潢等路農務。

translations.literal: On guiwei Households vice director Shangguan Yu was sent to investigate thoroughly flight from the Western Capital, to urge farming among frontier soldiers and civilians, and Households bureau director Li Jingyi was to arrange agricultural affairs on the Linhuang and other routes.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Vice Director of the Households Ministry Shangguan Yu was sent to investigate flight from the Western Capital and urge frontier soldiers and civilians to farm, while Bureau Director Li Jingyi of the Households Ministry was to arrange agriculture on the Linhuang and other routes.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，諭宰臣：「今後水潦旱蝗、盜賊竊發，命提刑司預為規畫。

translations.literal: On yiyou he instructed the chief ministers: “Hereafter, when flood, drought, locusts, or bandit raids break out, order the Judicial Inspection Commission to plan ahead.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he told the chief ministers, “When flood, drought, locusts, or bandit raids break out hereafter, the Judicial Inspection Commission is to plan ahead.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，諭西南路將士。

translations.literal: ” On wuzi he instructed the officers and soldiers of the Southwest Route.
translations.idiomatic: ” On wuzi he addressed the officers and soldiers of the Southwest Route.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，豫王永成進馬八十匹，賜詔獎諭，稱皇叔豫王而不名。

translations.literal: On gengyin the Prince of Yu, Yongcheng, presented eighty horses; an edict praised and instructed him, styling him Imperial Uncle Prince of Yu without using his personal name.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Prince of Yu, Yongcheng, presented eighty horses; an edict praised him, addressing him as Imperial Uncle Prince of Yu without using his personal name.
